sources.applied_rule: Require clear sourcing, evidence, Who/How/Why, explicit limits, and no unsupported expert identity.
Reviews should demonstrate expertise/experience and evidence; do not publish thin or invented review claims.
Prefer unique, non-commodity, people-first information with firsthand or source-backed value for AI search.
Do not use QAPage for static editorial FAQ/Q&A where users cannot submit alternative answers.
Review markup must represent a real review and connect the review body/author/item reviewed; ratings are not invented.

scope_note: These sources define editorial/structured-data guardrails. They do not prove agricultural product specifications or customer outcomes.
